这些抢匪一看就不是新手，他们分工明细，各司其职，根本不需要人指挥。

时笙暗骂几声晦气，不但被强制接了个隐藏任务，还特么的生命都受到威胁了。

关键是系统还不给金手指，简直是丧心病狂，差评！

剧情中原主这个时候，还在剧组中拍戏，自然不会经历这件事，但是这件事剧情中却是写得较为详细的，因为——女主在这里。

时笙刚才打量了一番，很可惜没看到女主，也不知道是不是在包间中。

夏满就是在这里救了陆清韵，陆清韵发现夏满和席墨关系不一般，从而接近夏满。

外面已经被警察重重包围，而抢匪也将包间里的人赶了出来。

夏满是从最后面的包间出来的，穿着修身的运动服，面容偏冷，看上去很镇定，按照抢匪的指挥，蹲在墙边，和时笙隔了两个人的距离。

夏满的表现不免让时笙多看了两眼。

“让开！”厉喝声打断了时笙视线，一个高大的抢匪站在她面前，那个服务员已经哭着让开了，抢匪进入包间。

包间里传来几声怒骂，接着两个人影就从包间中走了出来。

“蹲在这里，敢乱动就打死你！妈的，一个男人竟长这么漂亮……”

时笙感觉有人蹲了下来，她微微偏头，正好看见男人俊美白皙的侧脸，唇角轻抿，眉眼低垂，神色没什么变化。

即便的蹲着，他的姿势也极为优雅，四周的混杂和他格格不入，让人有种身处两个世界的错觉。

不知是不是察觉到时笙的视线，他偏头看过来，整张脸都暴露在时笙视线中，那是一张无法用言语来形容的脸，他扯着唇角笑了笑，漆黑如墨的瞳孔中刹那间犹如万千繁花绽放。

时笙恍惚了一下，她有种看到楚棠的错觉。

不过立即就被她否认了，这个男人和楚棠不一样。

楚棠身上是不动声色，引人堕入黑暗的邪气。而这个男人，他身上充满的是毫不掩饰，针锋相对的恶意。

系统你出来，本宝宝要和你谈谈人生。

为什么隐藏任务，都是这种变态？

本宝宝感觉生命受到了威胁，请求外挂金手指，好歹把新人礼包补发给本宝宝啊！

#宿主老是不忘新人礼包这个梗怎么办，在线等挺急的#

At first glance, these robbers are not novices. They have a detailed division of labor and perform their own duties. They do not need anyone to direct them at all.

Shi Sheng secretly cursed a few times for his bad luck. Not only was he forced to take on a hidden mission, but his life was also threatened.

The key is that the system doesn’t give you a golden finger, it’s just crazy and it’s a bad review!

In the plot, the original protagonist was still filming on the crew at this time, so naturally he would not experience this incident. However, this incident was written in more detail in the plot, because - the heroine is here.

Shi Sheng looked around just now, but unfortunately he didn't see the heroine, and he didn't know if she was in the private room.

It was here that Xia Man rescued Lu Qingyun. Lu Qingyun discovered that Xia Man and Xi Mo had an unusual relationship and got close to Xia Man.

The outside was heavily surrounded by police, and the robbers also kicked out the people in the private room.

Xia Man came out of the private room at the back, wearing slim-fitting sportswear, with a cold face and looking very calm. Following the robber's instructions, he squatted by the wall, two people away from Shi Sheng.

Xia Man's performance inevitably made Shi Sheng take a second look.

"Get out of the way!" A sharp shout interrupted Shi Sheng's sight. A tall robber stood in front of her. The waiter had already cried and got out of the way, and the robber entered the private room.

Several angry curses came from the private room, and then two figures walked out of the private room.

"Squat here and I'll beat you to death if you move! Damn, a man is so beautiful..."

Shi Sheng felt someone squatting down. She tilted her head slightly and saw the man's handsome and fair profile. The corners of his lips were slightly pursed, his eyebrows were lowered, and his expression did not change.

Even when squatting, his posture is extremely elegant, and the chaos around him is incompatible with him, giving people the illusion of being in two worlds.

Not sure if he noticed Shi Sheng's gaze, he turned his head and looked over. His entire face was exposed to Shi Sheng's gaze. It was a face that could not be described in words. He pulled the corners of his lips and smiled, and his dark pupils suddenly bloomed like thousands of flowers.

Shi Sheng was in a daze for a moment, and she had the illusion that she was seeing Chu Tang.

But she immediately denied that this man was different from Chu Tang.

Chu Tang has an evil aura about him that is calm and leads people to fall into darkness.And this man is full of unabashed, tit-for-tat malice.

When you come out of the system, I want to talk to you about life.

Why are hidden missions so perverted?

My baby feels that his life is under threat, so I request a cheat code to reissue the newbie gift pack to my baby!

#What should I do if the host always forgets about the gift package for newcomers? It’s quite urgent to wait online#
